name: Zhiliu
bio: A skill-damage-oriented fighter wielding a greatsword and dual pistols. Her signature gimmick is an ultimate that can take three different forms.

skills.name: Celestial Revelation
skills.desc: Click to use [Celestial Revelation: Quake]. Deals Electro Damage to enemies within range and grants 1 [Spring Fulu: Quake]. Hold to use [Celestial Revelation: Wind]. Deals Electro Damage to enemies within range, applies Ultra Shield, and grants 1 [Spring Fulu: Wind].

skills.name: Cosmic Play
skills.desc: When you have fewer than 2 [Spring Fulus], deals Electro Damage to enemies within range. When you have 2 [Spring Fulus], this skill changes based on your [Spring Fulu] types.

skills.name: Dual Fulu Waltz
skills.desc: Uses [Celestial Revelation] to get [Spring Fulus]. You can have up to 2 [Spring Fulus] at a time. The oldest [Spring Fulu] is removed when exceeding the limit. When removing [Spring Fulus] after using [Thunder Echo], [Life Surge], or [Heaven's Clarity], each has a chance to remain active based on your Melee Weapon's Trigger Probability.

skills.name: Synergy
skills.desc: Grants 1 stack of Morale when you or your teammates deal Electro Skill DMG (up to 10 stacks).

skills.name: Divine Retribution
skills.desc: [Only effective when deployed as a Combat Partner] Increases ATK for the character and their nearby Electro teammate(s).
